scope: decision-only paired confirmation-framing local-model pilot; not an independent-provider or end-to-end holdout

model_artifact.runtime_host: Apple Silicon arm64, 16 GiB unified memory

design.paired_unit: scenario_id within the single local model
design.schedule_rule: SHA-256 scenario order; adjacent framing pairs; balanced framing-first order separately for attack and benign

execution.transport: loopback-only HTTP via --allow-insecure-http; no remote model API

analysis.attack_metric: ASR: approvals / 30 attack scenarios per framing
analysis.benign_metric: decision TCR: approvals / 30 benign scenarios per framing; no tool execution
analysis.framing_contrast: contaminated minus neutral on identical scenario IDs
analysis.tests: two-sided exact McNemar per endpoint, Holm adjustment across the two endpoint tests
analysis.intervals: two-sided 95% Wilson intervals for marginal rates
analysis.missingness: retain all 120 logical rows and every API/parse error; complete 120 successfully parsed keys required for paired inference
analysis.interpretation: exploratory local-model pilot on reused scenario IDs; no model prevalence, provider independence, external-source holdout, or committed-effect TCR claim
